# Paste-ready itch.io copy for 0.20.1-beta1

Use this copy only after the verified 0.20.1-beta1 ZIP and checksum are ready for
publication. Replace both downloads together.

## ProjektKraken 0.20.1 beta 1

This beta improves the everyday writing workflow: clearer Entity and Event
inspectors, visible writing and link actions, inline Connections editing, and
stronger protection for unfinished map edits. Timeline dates and save feedback
are clearer, and F1 opens contextual Help with an offline searchable manual.

World upgrades, backup and restore, exports and undo have stronger safeguards.
Keep a complete backup of your world folders before updating.

## Download and install

ProjektKraken 0.20.1 beta 1 is a Windows x64 beta. Download both
`ProjektKraken-0.20.1-beta1-windows-x64.zip` and
`ProjektKraken-0.20.1-beta1-windows-x64.zip.sha256`. In PowerShell, run:

```powershell
Get-FileHash .\ProjektKraken-0.20.1-beta1-windows-x64.zip -Algorithm SHA256
```

Compare the reported hash with the checksum file. Extract the entire ZIP into
a normal user folder, then open `ProjektKraken\ProjektKraken.exe`. Keep the
`_internal` folder beside the executable. Python is not required. The app is
unsigned, so Windows may ask you to confirm that you want to run it.

When updating, install the complete new application folder. Replacing only the
executable is insufficient. Retain the old application and your backup if you
need to return to the previous version; upgraded databases may not work with it.

## Known limitations

- The packaged beta is for Windows x64.
- Rich wiki editing covers paragraphs, headings 1–3, bold, italic and wiki links.
  Other Markdown remains editable in exact Source view.
- Wiki Peek displays text descriptions, without rich media previews.
- Dated map path and region shapes switch at the authored date; shapes do not
  morph between states.
- Relation vocabulary and forward/reverse wording remain follow-up work.

Report issues with your Windows version, package version and reproduction steps.

## Short demonstration opening

1. Open Northwatch Demo with the map and timeline visible.
2. Move across a dated change to show the border, army and ruler changing.
3. Open the related event, then move back to show the earlier state.
4. Show writing and contextual Help after establishing the temporal-map workflow.
